note: On a wooded point on the north side of the Little River arm of J. Strom Thurmond (Clarks Hill) Lake, south end of Lincoln County - USACE land run by Georgia Freshwater Campgrounds with Broad River and Hester's Ferry. Gravel pads; boat ramp in the campground; marketed for church and group outings. --Claude
summary: Operator page confirms 17 sites (10 water/electric, 7 primitive) and online booking on its own Firefly page; changed dump false -> true (operator: 'A dump station for campers is also located inside the park') and added showers; booking platform -> operator with the Firefly URL. Fees ($20-35, AWH-saved Firefly read, manual) left; the operator site posts no rates and Firefly was not attempted (captcha). Amperage not stated by the operator (30A derived, left). Note cleaned (composting toilets / no dump station contradicted).
flags: Outside the federal booking system: USACE land leased to Georgia Freshwater Campgrounds, which books on its own Firefly engine, not recreation.gov - ownership is federal (concession); the federal row's rec.gov platform and 180-day window don't apply. Candidate for policy_ref none.
